description: Robo waters a flower and wonders: am I alive? With Duck and a mother bunny he finds three clues (living things grow, need food and water, and make new living things), sorts tricky things into alive and not alive hoops (a toy car, a seed, a cloud, a mushroom, a worm, a ball) and finds that he is not alive, but still everyone's friend.

youtube.title: Alive or Not? Living and Non-Living Things for Preschool | Toy Box Friends
youtube.description:
Is Robo alive? Robo, Duck and a mother bunny look for three clues: living things grow, living things need food and water, and living things make new living things like themselves. A seed grows into a flower, a baby bunny grows, a chick hatches from an egg. Then kids sort tricky things into the alive hoop and the not alive hoop: a toy car moves but is not alive, a seed sits still but is alive, a cloud grows but is not alive. And Robo? He's not alive, but he's still everyone's friend!

Try it at home with a grown-up: go on an alive walk and point to things (a tree, a stone, a bird, a bike, an ant). Check the three clues! Or grow a bean in a cup: press a dry bean against damp paper towel in a clear cup and watch it grow a root and a shoot. Don't eat the beans, wash your hands after touching soil or bugs, and put little animals back gently where you found them.

Made for kids. Toy Box Friends: 3D learning videos for preschool.

do.text: Duck... the flower is alive. You are alive. Am I alive?
You move! You talk! You must be!
Hmm. Let's be detectives and find out!
Here is a seed. And here is a rock.
The seed grew into a flower!
And the rock? It stays the same.
Hello! This is my baby. A baby bunny is called a kit.
She is little now. She will grow big, like me!
Clue two. Living things need food and water.
And I drink water. Sip, sip!
The rock needs nothing. No food. No water.
Living things need food and water!
Clue three. Living things make babies, like themselves.
Look! An egg in a nest!
The bunny has a baby bunny.
Living things make new living things!
Does it need food and water?

scenes.title: The car moves... is it alive?

do.text: Let's sort! Alive things go on the green mat. Not alive things go on the grey mat.
Does it need food and water?
The car moves, but it is not alive.
A seed. It doesn't move. Alive or not?
Alive! A seed is resting. Give it water, and it grows!
Some seeds wait a very long time, then grow!
A cloud. It moves, and it grows bigger!
No! A cloud needs no food, and makes no babies.
Alive! A worm grows, eats, and has babies.
Not alive! A ball never grows.
I need a battery, not food.
Do I grow? No. I stay the same size.
Can I make baby robots? No!
I'm not alive. But I'm still your friend!
Quiz time! Point to the green mat or the grey mat.
One. A flower. Alive or not?
Two. A rock. Alive or not?
Three. The toy car moves. Is it alive?
Four. A baby bunny. Alive or not?
